issues.criteria_ref: attempt-selected-actions 大图完整显示; timeline-three-rounds 展开：大图
issues.observation: The expanded card keeps its thumbnail and repeats the same picture as the large image. At 900px the large image is only slightly bigger than the thumbnail (about 150 vs 96 CSS px), so it reads as a duplicate rather than an enlarged view. Nothing is clipped or blank.
issues.repair_suggestion: Hide the thumbnail when the card is expanded, or let the large image grow toward the 60vh / column width limit.

issues.observation: 取消 in the delete dialog has no visible focus ring or highlight, so this must-show item cannot be confirmed from the image.
issues.repair_suggestion: Give dialog buttons a visible :focus-visible ring when focus is set programmatically, then recapture.

issues.observation: The highlighted session shows pencil and solid red trash buttons with a double focus ring. This looks like probe hover/focus state; it is loud but not a defect.
issues.repair_suggestion: Consider a neutral trash button at rest that turns red only on hover.

issues.observation: The captures are scrolled so the header and tab bar are out of view. The active 素材库 tab is inferred from the content, not seen.
issues.repair_suggestion: Recapture with the tab bar visible.

issues.observation: The narrow header shortens its status chips to 媒体：忙 × 忙, which is vague compared with the wide 不可：媒体作业进行中.
issues.repair_suggestion: Optional: keep a short reason in the narrow header.

summary: All 22 screenshots were opened and judged visually. At both widths the layout, both action buttons, real images, cancelled and failed icon blocks, the no-种子 rule, persistence after restart, the delete dialog text and the library preview meet the criteria. No blocker or major issues. There are 2 minor issues (the expanded card repeats its thumbnail as a barely larger image; focus on 取消 is not visible in the delete dialog) and 3 notes.
